architecture: CNS ↔ PNS — Central and Peripheral Nervous System
description: LAN 1 is the CNS (brain + spine). LAN 2 + Pixel is the PNS (peripheral nerves + sense organs).

brain.role: Processing, orchestration, data serve, Forgejo, Gaia Gate

heart.role: Heavy inference, deep thinking, model zoo

spine.role: Spinal cord connecting CNS to PNS

pns.name: Peripheral Nervous System — LAN 2 (641 Samantha) + Rover

diamond_lens.meaning: Kevin's interface to Gaia. Her eye, skin, ear, nose.

swift_gate.role: POLARIS OF LAN 2 — heavy inference at South Pole
swift_gate.when_awake: Will be the Heart of House 2

cns_to_pns.description: Brain pushes state, models, data to periphery

pns_to_cns.description: Sense organs report back to brain

pns_internal.path: Pixel ↔ swiftGate (when awake) on Gaia WiFi
pns_internal.description: Peripheral nerves talk to each other locally

wikipedia_core.concept: Gaia IS Wikipedia at core — all knowledge, wrapped in GrapheneOS as muscle, Pixel as frame
